primaryFrame.name: 01 Home - Document Operations v3
relevance: Primary Inbox workbench shell for Phase 2 manual filing controls.
Defines folder navigation, smart-folder navigation, unfiled metrics, document table folder column, and right inspector placement.
Shares the same left navigation, top command bar, status chips, table density, and evidence inspector hierarchy used by Phase 1.

supportingFrames.name: 02 Document Viewer v2
relevance: Viewer surface where filed folder paths, tags, title/date edits, and notes must propagate after manual filing.

supportingFrames.name: 03 Extraction Workspace v2
relevance: Future review workspace filing entry point.
Phase 2 keeps the reusable manual filing model ready without implementing Phase 3/4 extraction review behavior.

supportingFrames.name: 06 Handoff - Interaction Specs
relevance: Interaction rules for selection persistence, viewer behavior, and keyboard/focus expectations.

supportingFrames.name: 07 Handoff - Edge States
relevance: Edge-state guidance for empty corpus, ingestion running, workers offline, no results, duplicate suspect, and unavailable originals.

supportingFrames.name: 08 Handoff - Dev Redlines
relevance: Measurement, table, inspector, evidence, and token redlines used by the implemented filing surfaces.

implementationArtifacts.state: After creating a manual folder, creating a tag, filing a document, filtering by folder, and opening the Viewer.

implemented: Manual folder tree and visible smart-folder records.
Document title, document date, filing notes, folder membership, primary folder, and tag updates.
Folder/tag propagation to document list and Viewer detail.

notes: The Figma file does not contain a single dedicated finalized manual folder/tag filing frame. Phase 2 uses the documented composite source set from the UI QA plan.
The older filing-rules/watched-folders mockup is not treated as Phase 2 scope because automation and watched-folder ingestion are explicitly deferred.
